title: A Cross-Cultural Comparison of LLM-based Public Opinion Simulation: Evaluating Chinese and U.S. Models on Diverse Societies
findings: The paper included 'religious beliefs' as a demographic variable for simulating U.S. public opinion prompts. However, it did not present or analyze any results based on this variable, focusing instead on political, economic, and educational demographics.
